2. The plaintiff claimed the suit land by virtue of purchase by a registered kabala dared 30th Falgoon 1353 B.S. corresponding to 14th March, 1947 A.D. At the time of purchase Vender's guard, Hasumia, was in possession, but as he refused to deliver the possession, he filed. Title suit No. 5 of 1950 and took delivery of possession through court on 27th May, 1951 in execution of a decree for eviction, passed in that suit. 

 4. The present appellant defendant No. 2, alone contested the suit. His case is that the suit land is the ancestral property of defendants Nos. 1-7; that they have been possessing the same from the time of their ancestors and that the decree in Title suit No. 5 of 1950 is collusive, fraudulent and not binding upon the defendants.
